description: Unit test class for ImmutableJsonBoolean, testing immutability, equality, boolean value retrieval, string representation, and type assertions.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonBooleanTest
classes.description: Test class for ImmutableJsonBoolean to verify behavior and correctness.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ImmutableJsonBoolean instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonBoolean instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: asBooleanReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the boolean value returned matches the initialized value.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks the string representation of the immutable boolean.

methods.name: isNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that the object is not null and is recognized as a boolean.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Confirms that the object is identified as a boolean value.

methods.name: isNotNumber
methods.description: Verifies that the boolean is not misidentified as a number types.

methods.name: isNotString
methods.description: Verifies that it is not mistaken for a string.

methods.name: isNotObject
methods.description: Verifies that it is not mistaken for a JSON object.

methods.name: isNotArray
methods.description: Verifies that it is not mistaken for a JSON array.

methods.name: tryToGetAsInt
methods.description: Tests that requesting an int from a boolean throws an UnsupportedOperationException with the correct message.

methods.name: tryToGetAsLong
methods.description: Tests that requesting a long from a boolean throws an exception.

methods.name: tryToGetAsDouble
methods.description: Tests that requesting a double throws an exception.

methods.name: tryToGetAsString
methods.description: Tests that requesting a string throws an exception.

methods.name: tryToGetAsObject
methods.description: Tests that requesting an object throws an exception.

methods.name: tryToGetAsArray
methods.description: Tests that requesting an array throws an exception.
